lvl1_solution.claim: Key: tip block on shaft; goal=slide tip into head. Arrow keys move tip (LEFT toward head). 4x4 tip blocked by narrow neck; pad 'submit' (lit set == initial white plus pattern) shrinks tip 4x4->2x2, letting it pass neck.
